description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND +50% (25s)], [Conditional Attach Element From Party], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Record Keeper Mode I: Tyro] and [Ability Resonance +3% Boost] to the user, Grants [Ability Resonance +2% Boost] to all Core or Beyond allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Record Keeper Mode I: Tyro
description.text: Increase the damage/healing cap by 10000, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark and Poison abilities deal 50% more damage, instant cast speed, casts Dual Clearsight Grimoire after using an ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Record Keeper Mode II: Tyro] to the user, Grants [Weakness +15% Boost 1]/[ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +15% (25s)], [Weakness +50% Boost 1] and [Instant Cast 1] to all allies if there are 0-3/4+ Core or Beyond allies, removes [Dual Awoken Record Keeper Mode I: Tyro]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Record Keeper Mode II: Tyro
description.text: Cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Dual Protection Grimoire after using an ability

description.name: Dual Protection Grimoire
description.text: One single hybrid attacks (5.92 or 24.78) capped at 9999/19999 if 2+ Core/Beyond allies aren't/are alive, ignores DEF and RES, 100% hit rate, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +50% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 50% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Dual Clearsight Grimoire
description.text: Ten single hybrid attacks (0.12/0.19/0.26/0.32/0.39 or 0.41/0.64/0.87/1.10/1.33 each) at triggering ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, 100% hit rate

description.name: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND +50% (25s)
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND +50%

description.name: Conditional Attach Element From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark]/[Attach Poison] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted
